say:6:1010512001:0.text: N-No way! It's unmistakable! The liquid is filled with corrupted <style="highlight">magic from the leylines</style>!
say:6:1010512001:0.source_cn: 这、这是！错不了，液体中全是被污染的地脉魔力！

say:7:1010512002:0.text: If any guests were to drink this stuff, they would completely lose their minds!
say:7:1010512002:0.source_cn: 如果宾客们喝下这些饮料，他们将完全丧失神智！

say:8:1010512003:2.text: After that, they would just pass out... Right?
say:8:1010512003:2.source_cn: 丧失神智后……是会昏倒对吗？

say:9:1010512004:0.text: No, even worse. They shall become pliable, obedient... puppets.
say:9:1010512004:0.source_cn: 不，比昏倒更糟，他们会变成一具具任人摆布的……傀儡。

say:10:1010512005:0.text: All guests in attendance are rich and powerful nobles. Lord Franz sure knows how to treat his guests, huh?
